Control your AirPods on Xiaomi HyperOS, with battery display, noise control and more.

P.O.D.S. is derived from HyperPods. It retains protocol, control, artwork and other source contributions by Art_Chen and inherited fork contributors including Mo-SeTian.\n\nThe imported baseline is pinned to a44bc10e387f527062b9ba2b8f90b154b2e61248. P.O.D.S. maintains independent Git history; upstream notices remain in the source.

The project retains its GPLv3 license and inherited file-level notices, including AGPLv3 notices in AACP sources. Refer to the source and individual files for the applicable terms. Independent history does not remove upstream attribution or license obligations.
